---
title: Noob hydrology
---
Goal: 
Simulate how a flood might affect the road network. 
Use PBF editing methods to create a "flooded" map; where the road network is broken at the identified points. 
Inputs: DEM 10m tif, OpenStreetMap PBF
- Used DDM Hydrologic in QGIS to generate flowpaths and cachements. (HEAVY ram usage) 

Flooding is simulated by breaking roads that intersect with high enough strahler flowpaths. There are settings to exclude certain built up infrastructure such as bridges/highways. The map is created, then converted to obf via osmandmapcreator. This finished map can be used to simulate alternative pathing in a "flooded" environment.
